# Curation report (generated by `python3 -m ingest.curate.rank`)

Scanned 2,438,690 raw lines; 2,235,736 recipes passed the build's drops; 1,858,555 survived the junk filters and the dedupe (the ranked pool); 80,000 selected.

## Ratings join

recipenlg food.com URLs: 499,616; joined to a Food.com interactions rating: 156,000 (31.2%). Rated records across all sources: 156,980; mean rating 4.618 (score.RATING_PRIOR = 4.6).

Proxy (BAR.md): Spearman rho between the content score and the Bayesian rating on 58,542 pool recipes with >= 3 ratings: -0.0378 (p = 6.4e-20). Per term: domain -0.0004, parse -0.0345, qty -0.0369, steps -0.0094, lines -0.003, time 0.0012, pop 0.2204, extras 0.0298, copies (cluster size - 1) 0.0406 (popularity includes the review count, so its rho is partly mechanical).
